## What happened?

Describe expected and actual behavior. For a vulnerability, use the private reporting link in SECURITY.md instead of this issue.

## Reproduce

Provide minimal steps and synthetic input. Never attach passwords, tokens, SSH keys, router backups, private addresses, raw speed-test results, real history or private configuration. Inspect and redact screenshots and output before posting.

## Environment

- Core and UI package versions (or source commit):
- Router model and exact firmware:
- Browser/version (UI problems):
- jq version (CLI problems):
- Development OS/Python/Lua versions (development tools only):

## Readiness and errors

List readiness status/check names and sanitized error codes, if relevant. Do not paste full configuration or raw backend output. Was this a manual test, scheduled test, import, export or passive-quality observation?

## Verification

What did you try? Which checks ran, and what remains untested?
